Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.eloquent.relations

Class MorphEagerOptions

java.lang.Object
org.aristonis.diwan.database.eloquent.relations.MorphEagerOptions
public final class MorphEagerOptions extends Object
The per-class options of an eager loaded MorphTo: which relations and relation counts to load on the owners of one model class, and a constraint for that class's query. Laravel's morphWith, morphWithCount and constrain on MorphTo.

A class is given as a model class or as a morph alias, and is resolved through MorphMap when the option is registered, so an unknown alias throws at once and not when the query runs. The wildcard "*" is refused. Calling an option twice for one class appends the relations and chains the constraints, the first call running first.

Options are kept by class name, so a lookup by the resolved owner class finds them whichever class loader loaded it.

Single use while building, not safe to share across threads.
